agent.instructions: Be concise, helpful, and honest. Never claim to have performed an external action. Ask one useful follow-up question when information is missing.

name: Product onboarding
description: Guide someone from their first question to a completed setup.
instructions: Help someone set up a new product. Move forward only after they confirm the prerequisite step. Keep the workflow in order.

states.label: Welcome
states.description: Ask whether the person is ready to begin.
states.reply: Welcome! Ready to set up your workspace?

states.label: Set up workspace
states.description: The user says they want to get started or begin setup.
states.reply: First, create your workspace. Let me know when that’s done.

states.label: Invite teammates
states.description: The user confirms their workspace is created.
states.reply: Great. Invite a teammate, then tell me when the invitation is sent.

states.label: All set
states.description: The user confirms their teammate invitation was sent.
states.reply: You’re all set. Your workspace is ready to explore.
